Ask.description:
A thing the owner asks for by its name and its maker's address, and, for a follow-up, the earlier research
it follows from.

because.description: the words the ask is made with: why it is asked

followsDocumentId.description: for a follow-up: the document it follows from

followsItemId.description: for a follow-up: the item it follows from

BranchAsk.description: A branch asked of a research run.

BranchEnd.description: A branch at its end: its index in its run, how it ended, what it wrote and why it failed.

CalendarTarget.description: The calendar a topic's dated findings are written to.

calendar.description: the calendar a `topic` category's dated findings are written to; null where it writes none

gatherMinutes.description: for a `brief` or a `topic` category, how often it is gathered into one run

instruction.description: a `topic` category's own question; null for another shape

provider.description: its road; null where the settings' stands

CategoryChange.description:
A change of a category; a field left out keeps what it holds, an empty road gives the settings' back, and
a calendar given as null stops a topic writing to one.

calendar.description: left out keeps the calendar, null takes it away

CategoryShape.description: What a run of a category's items is asked for.

CategoryState.description: One category's state and its part of the queue.

finishingCount.description: its items whose page is finished before they are told

runningCount.description: its items carried by a try whose run holds a place

stuckCount.description: its items stuck past their retries, still asked on every retry wait

waitingCount.description: its items in the queue for a place

DaemonState.description:
The daemon's state: stopped where every category is stopped, each category's, and the places that wait
for their engine.

changedAt.description: epoch milliseconds; the latest change of any category's state, null where none was changed

runId.description: the research run whose brief held it

Failure.description: A failure, in the wire format's one error shape.

Filter.description: The words an item must carry and the words that rule it out.

Hold.description: A place asked that waits for its engine now (`docs/api.md`, 「The engine」).

categoryNames.description: the running categories on the place's road, whose tries it may take

cause.description:
the master's reason the card waits (`starting`, `in-use`, `held` or `start-failed`); null where it gave
none

causeText.description: the master's sentence for that reason

demandId.description: the arbiter demand it waits on; null until the master has answered the ask

place.description: the request key of the place that waits

registration.description: the registration the place's road goes out on

reported.description: whether the owner's room was told the engine has not come

serviceName.description: the arbiter service whose card it waits for

since.description: epoch milliseconds; when the demand was asked

HoldReason.description: Why a place asked is not let in now: it waits for the arbiter to grant its engine's card.

error.description: why its latest try failed or was interrupted: that try's outcome, not how the item stands now

jobItemId.description: the job item the chat agent filed for it

languages.description: the languages the document's page holds, Korean first; empty before a document is filed

narrations.description: the languages whose narration the document's page plays, Korean first

pending.description:
what the document's page still lacks before its report is told: `korean`, `narration-ko`,
`narration-en`; empty where it lacks nothing

pendingRetryAt.description: when what the page lacks is asked again, or none where nothing is pending

plan.description: the heading of the document's plan section

repairItemId.description: the job item filed for the repair worker while it is stuck, to fix the cause

runId.description: the research run of the latest try

title.description: the head the run gave its document, in English

touches.description: the repositories and hosts an advisory touches

ItemChange.description: A change of an item: dismiss it, mark it taken, or ask a stuck one again by `state`, or move it to the front.

jobItemId.description: with `taken`: the job item the chat agent filed

ItemState.description:
An item's place in its life (`docs/api.md`, 「queue」): `skipped` stands for an advisory the run judged
outside the platform's age floor before researching it, with no document and no notice.

NewCategory.description: A category asked to be registered.

NewRecipient.description: A recipient asked to be added.

NewSource.description: A source asked to be registered.

pattern.description: which links of a `page` source's listing are posts: a path prefix, else a regular expression

strategy.description: how a `page` source's listing is read: `direct` or `browser`

NewStackRow.description: A stack row asked to be added.

Origin.description: Where an item came from; the fields its kind does not use are null.

because.description: the words the ask was made with: the owner's for `asked`, why it was asked for `follow-up`

documentId.description: for `follow-up`: the document it follows from

itemId.description: for `follow-up`: the item it follows from

shareUrl.description: for `follow-up`: that document's live link, as it stood when the ask was made

source.description: for `source`: the source that found it, by its kind and what it reads; null where it no longer stands

title.description: for `follow-up`: that document's title, as it stood when the ask was made

OriginKind.description:
What an item came from (`docs/api.md`, 「queue」): a source's scan, the owner's ask, or an ask made from an
earlier research.

Page.description: A list, one page of it: the items and whether more stand past the last.

Page2.description: A list, one page of it: the items and whether more stand past the last.

Page3.description: A list, one page of it: the items and whether more stand past the last.

Page4.description: A list, one page of it: the items and whether more stand past the last.

Page5.description: A list, one page of it: the items and whether more stand past the last.

Page6.description: A list, one page of it: the items and whether more stand past the last.

Page7.description: A list, one page of it: the items and whether more stand past the last.

RecipientKind.description: Whether a recipient is a room or an agent.

ResearchKeySettings.description: One research key's settings: its branches and its budget.

branchPages.description:
the most pages each branch fetches; none for no ceiling. Left out of a change, it keeps what the key
holds.

pages.description:
the most pages the first answer fetches; none for no ceiling. Left out of a change, it keeps what the
key holds.

ResearchLog.description: A research run's log, oldest first.

ResearchLogLine.description: One line of a research run's log.

ResearchRun.description: A research run as it was asked: its id, its key, its slot's state and the road its slot stands on.

ResearchRunAsk.description: A research asked of the runner (`docs/api.md`, 「research runs」).

model.description: the model the run goes out on; its slot's where none is named

options.description: the search's options as text, or a `references` run's as an object (or the same JSON as a string)

provider.description:
the provider the run goes out on, named only with its model; where a model alone is named, the one an
agent of its role holds that model under; its slot's where none is named

roomId.description: the room the result is told to; the owner's private room where none is named

ResearchRunView.description: One research run as the runner's ledger holds it.

narrations.description: the languages whose narration its document plays

outcome.description: `answered`, `failed` or `cut`; null while the run is open

pending.description: what its document still lacks, its room told once it lacks nothing

turns.description: the names of the agency turns it went out under

ResearchSettings.description: What every research run is held to, and the search engines' state.

branchRole.description: the role a branch's slot is asked under and its session holds

engineIntervalMs.description: null where the web tools' default stands

engines.description: null where they could not be read

enginesUnread.description: why the engines' state could not be read, where it could not

hostIntervalMs.description: null where the web tools' default stands

source.description: `default` where the settings file's stand, `set` once changed

ResearchSettingsChange.description:
A change to the research settings: a field left out keeps what it holds, and a gap given as null returns
to the web tools' default.

Run.description: The daemon's record of one try of an item.

SearchEngineState.description: One search engine's state, as the web tools answer it.

Shape.description: The shape an item's research run is asked in.

failureCount.description: readings failed since the last that did not

lastError.description: the last reading's failure sentence, null when it succeeded

lastTaken.description: of those, the ones kept as new, each waiting for a slot in the queue

lastYield.description: candidates the last reading that succeeded turned up past the filter

pattern.description: a `page` source's link pattern, null for another kind

readAt.description: epoch milliseconds of the last reading, failed or not

strategy.description: how a `page` source's listing is read, `direct` or `browser`; null for another kind

SourceChange.description: A change of a source; a field left out keeps what it holds.

pattern.description: which links of a `page` source's listing are posts: a path prefix, else a regular expression

strategy.description: how a `page` source's listing is read: `direct` or `browser`

StackRow.description: A row of the platform's stack inventory.

StateChange.description: A change of the daemon's state, for every category or for the one named.

bearer.description: The daemon's token, from the file its settings name under the data root's env/.

info.description: The research unit: a daemon that keeps a queue of things to research by category, reads the sources the owner registers, has each item researched by its own runner in its category's shape, and tells the category's recipients. It files no job and launches nothing.
info.title: bmo-research
